title: Composition of unit-normalized adjunction lifts
statement: Let A, B, C, D be categories, with adjunctions P:B→A ⊣ R, Q:D→B ⊣ S and T:D→A ⊣ V. Let U:A→C, U':B→C, U'':D→C admit left adjoints J, J', J'', respectively. Let α:U'≅P⋙U, β:U''≅Q⋙U', γ:U''≅T⋙U and τ:T≅Q⋙P satisfy β_N followed by α_(QN) = γ_N followed by U(τ_N) for every N. For an object K of C, put Nr=α_(RJK) followed by U(εP_JK), Ns=β_(SJ'K) followed by U'(εQ_J'K), Nc=γ_(VJK) followed by U(εT_JK). Suppose u:J'K→RJK, v:J''K→SJ'K and w:J''K→VJK satisfy the original open-unit normalizations: the J' adjunct of u followed by Nr is ηJ_K, the J'' adjunct of v followed by Ns is ηJ'_K, and the J'' adjunct of w followed by Nc is ηJ_K. If the last normalization has a unique solution, then w = v followed by S(u) followed by the component at JK of the right-adjoint conjugate of τ. No isomorphism assumption on Nr, Ns, Nc is needed beyond the stated unique normalization.

proof.text: For adjunctions P ⊣ R, Q ⊣ S, T ⊣ V, comparison isomorphisms U' ≅ P U, U'' ≅ Q U', U'' ≅ T U and T ≅ Q P satisfying their component triangle, the restriction of the mate compositor equals the two successive restricted counits. Rewrite comparison naturality, the conjugate counit identity and the composite counit formula. Formal category and adjunction identities: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Mates; composed adjunction associativity in the proved source library.

For two arrows normalized by successive open-adjunction units, expand Hom equivalences as unit followed by the right adjoint. Functoriality, the restricted-counit equation, comparison naturality and counit naturality give the unit normalization of their composite followed by the mate compositor. Formal category and adjunction identities: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Mates; composed adjunction associativity in the proved source library.

The assumed unique composite normalization identifies its specified arrow with that composite. Formal category and adjunction identities: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Mates; composed adjunction associativity in the proved source library.

lean.statement:
theorem unitNormalizedLift_comp
    {A B C D : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
    {P : B ⥤ A} {R : A ⥤ B} {Q : D ⥤ B} {S : B ⥤ D}
    {T : D ⥤ A} {V : A ⥤ D}
    (ap : P ⊣ R) (aq : Q ⊣ S) (ac : T ⊣ V)
    (U : A ⥤ C) (U' : B ⥤ C) (U'' : D ⥤ C)
    (J : C ⥤ A) (J' : C ⥤ B) (J'' : C ⥤ D)
    (aj : J ⊣ U) (aj' : J' ⊣ U') (aj'' : J'' ⊣ U'')
    (α : U' ≅ P ⋙ U) (β : U'' ≅ Q ⋙ U') (gamma : U'' ≅ T ⋙ U)
    (τ : T ≅ Q ⋙ P)
    (hc : ∀ N, β.hom.app N ≫ α.hom.app (Q.obj N) =
      gamma.hom.app N ≫ U.map (τ.hom.app N)) (K : C)
    (Nr : U'.obj (R.obj (J.obj K)) ⟶ U.obj (J.obj K))
    (Ns : U''.obj (S.obj (J'.obj K)) ⟶ U'.obj (J'.obj K))
    (Nc : U''.obj (V.obj (J.obj K)) ⟶ U.obj (J.obj K))
    (hNr : Nr = α.hom.app (R.obj (J.obj K)) ≫ U.map (ap.counit.app (J.obj K)))
    (hNs : Ns = β.hom.app (S.obj (J'.obj K)) ≫ U'.map (aq.counit.app (J'.obj K)))
    (hNc : Nc = gamma.hom.app (V.obj (J.obj K)) ≫ U.map (ac.counit.app (J.obj K)))
    (u : J'.obj K ⟶ R.obj (J.obj K)) (v : J''.obj K ⟶ S.obj (J'.obj K))
    (w : J''.obj K ⟶ V.obj (J.obj K))
    (hu : aj'.homEquiv K (R.obj (J.obj K)) u ≫ Nr = aj.unit.app K)
    (hv : aj''.homEquiv K (S.obj (J'.obj K)) v ≫ Ns = aj'.unit.app K)
    (hw : aj''.homEquiv K (V.obj (J.obj K)) w ≫ Nc = aj.unit.app K)
    (hun : ∃! w' : J''.obj K ⟶ V.obj (J.obj K),
      aj''.homEquiv K (V.obj (J.obj K)) w' ≫ Nc = aj.unit.app K) :
    w = v ≫ S.map u ≫ (conjugateEquiv (aq.comp ap) ac τ.hom).app (J.obj K)
